decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to use aggressive creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Terravore to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Weathered Wayfarer and Mox Diamond, the deck can accelerate its mana production and play powerful spells like Armageddon to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Naturalize allows for removal of threats and answers to potential obstacles. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to control the board state while efficiently ramping up to land destruction with Terravore and Armageddon.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with enchantments like Parallax Tide and Wave using cards like Attunement and Intuition. Once your graveyard is full, you can play Replenish to bring all those enchantments back onto the battlefield, potentially creating a powerful board state with Opalescence turning them into creatures. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Mana Leak and Seal of Cleansing to help protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on swarming the opponent with a rapid onslaught of aggressive Goblin creatures, backed up by powerful support cards like Goblin Ringleader and Siege-Gang Commander. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly, utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat creatures into play and cards like Gempalm Incinerator to clear the way for attacks. With a combination of speed, synergy, and disruption with cards like Wasteland and Naturalize, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent before they can establish a solid defense.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Replenish and various enchantments such as Parallax Wave, Opalescence, and Parallax Tide to repeatedly return and abuse powerful enchantments from the graveyard. The deck also includes cards like Attunement and Frantic Search to help dig through the deck and find key pieces. Mana Leak and Stifle provide disruption for the opponent's strategies, while Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing provide removal options. The deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while disrupting their game plan with spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The deck also has some card draw and recursion options to maintain pressure on the opponent. With a mix of efficient creatures and versatile spells, this deck can quickly establish a dominant board presence and keep the opponent on the back foot throughout the game.

The deck focuses on setting up an infinite combo with Aluren, using creatures like Raven Familiar, Wall of Blossoms, and Wall of Roots to draw cards and generate mana for the combo. Cabal Therapy is used to disrupt the opponent's strategy while Survival of the Fittest helps find key combo pieces. The deck also includes graveyard recursion with Unearth and utilizes creatures like Mesmeric Fiend for additional disruption. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and win the game through a loop of creature abilities.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat creatures into play, along with a mix of disruptive spells like Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mana base designed for consistency and disruption with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port, the deck looks to quickly build a board presence and close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Goblin creatures and quickly deal damage before they can stabilize. The deck utilizes cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly get creatures onto the battlefield, supported by cards like Goblin Piledriver and Goblin Ringleader to strengthen the board presence. This deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Gempalm Incinerator to deal with threats from the opponent. Overall, the key strategy is to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain momentum throughout the game.

This Goblin deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a swarm of aggressive creatures, fueled by Goblin Lackey's ability to cheat them into play. The deck includes powerful Goblin tribal cards like Goblin Matron, Goblin Piledriver, and Goblin Ringleader to generate card advantage and deal massive damage. Other key cards like Goblin Warchief and Siege-Gang Commander provide additional support and power. The inclusion of removal spells like Gempalm Incinerator and Diabolic Edict help control the battlefield, while utility lands like Rishadan Port and Wasteland disrupt the opponent's resources.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Ravenous Rats, while also having support cards like Grim Lavamancer and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The goal is to apply constant pressure and disrupt your opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy. The inclusion of cards like The Rack and Cursed Scroll adds another layer of damage and control to the deck. Overall, the focus is on fast, efficient aggression and disruption to secure a win.

The deck focuses on using a variety of counterspells, removal, and card draw to control the opponent's actions and eventually win the game through land-based threats such as Mishra's Factory and Faerie Conclave. Cards like Nevinyrral's Disk and Powder Keg provide board control, while Force Spike and Mana Leak disrupt the opponent's plays. Stifle can also be used to counter key abilities. The deck aims to outlast the opponent by generating card advantage and maintaining control over the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo between Replenish and various enchantments like Opalescence, Parallax Tide, and Parallax Wave to control the board and create a win condition. It also includes cards like Intuition and Attunement to set up the combo pieces quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Tsabo's Web and Seal of Cleansing provide additional utility and disruption for the opponent. The mana base is built to support the combo and ensure consistency in casting the necessary spells.

The main focus of this Aggro-Sligh deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent by using low-cost, efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game, utilizing cards like Grim Lavamancer, Jackal Pup, and Mogg Fanatic to chip away at their life total. Fireblast, Incinerate, Lightning Bolt, and Price of Progress provide additional reach and removal, while cards like Cursed Scroll and Sulfuric Vortex help maintain pressure and close out the game quickly.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by playing low-cost creatures and burn spells. By utilizing fast creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on. The inclusion of cards like Ball Lightning and Sulfuric Vortex helps to maintain the tempo and keep the pressure on throughout the game. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with consistent damage and finish them off with direct burn spells.

The deck focuses on quickly reducing the opponent's life total by aggressively deploying efficient creatures and burn spells to control the board. It aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base with Land Destruction spells while maintaining pressure with aggressive creatures like Blistering Firecat, Jackal Pup, and Mogg Fanatic. The deck utilizes a low mana curve and a high density of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate to efficiently deal damage to the opponent. Overall, the strategy revolves around quick and consistent aggression to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck revolves around assembling the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat with minimal drawback. The deck utilizes various card draw and counterspell options to protect the combo and control the game. Using cards like Gush and Foil to generate card advantage while disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to quickly put pressure on the opponent while maintaining a strong grip on the game through counter magic and deck manipulation.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out Phyrexian Dreadnought, a powerful creature with a downside, and then using cards like Stifle and Foil to counter any attempts to remove it. The deck also includes card draw and search spells to help find the necessary pieces for the combo. With a heavy emphasis on countering and disrupting the opponent's plays, the deck aims to win through the powerful synergy between Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Nimble Mongoose and Terravore to pressure the opponent while also disrupting their mana base with cards like Armageddon and Wasteland. By ramping into powerful threats like Terravore early on and using cards like Sylvan Library to draw into more threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Naturalize allow for interaction with the opponent's threats and strategies, while also protecting against any potential board wipes or problematic permanents.

The main theme of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the game through counterspells, removal, and creatures with protection. By using cards like Swords to Plowshares, Mana Leak, and Meddling Mage, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while building up its own board presence with creatures like Exalted Angel and Silver Knight. The inclusion of Standstill as a card draw engine and Wasteland for land destruction adds to the deck's control aspect, while Weathered Wayfarer helps in searching for specific lands.
